name: headsup-ai
description: Gives your AI a heads-up before it answers.

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.build:ext: tsup extension/src/background.ts extension/src/content.ts extension/src/popup.ts --format iife --target chrome120 --out-dir extension/build --clean && for f in background content popup; do mv extension/build/$f.global.js extension/build/$f.js; done && cp -R extension/manifest.json extension/popup.html extension/icons extension/build/
scripts.gate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && tsx sim/gate.ts
